summary: Vanessa McMichael, 58, PE teacher at Midland International Elementary School and two-time Pikes Peak Ascent finisher, suffered apparent cardiac arrest ~1/3 up the Manitou Incline; an off-duty paramedic performed CPR, and EPCSAR + Manitou Fire responded but could not revive her.
responding_agency: El Paso County Search and Rescue; Manitou Fire Department
notes: Date approximate — bounds: the manitouincline.com report says "this afternoon" and cites the Micah True autopsy news that broke 2012-05-08; the Gazette follow-up profile ("Incline hiker was known for fitness") ran 2012-05-10 (PPLD record); the blog post sits in the news archive between the May-3 and May-12 posts. Best estimate Tuesday 2012-05-08; 2012-05-09 possible. Identity confirmed via obituary + Gazette profile. Run 622 EPSO chunk.
